We need to determine appropriate criminal charge(s) for this case. Facts: Defendant set fire to grass (by lighting weeds) while doing farm work, causing fire that burned mango seedlings (non-forest land). Over 9.6 hectares (144.5 mu) of non-forest land, 10065 seedlings destroyed, value 75,279 yuan. No mention of intent to cause fire, just accidental? He intentionally lit weeds, but maybe negligent. In Chinese criminal law, there is crime of "失火" (unlawful fire) or "放火" (arson). The examples: earlier similar case with burning forest area: they labeled "失火". For example: first example: Liu甲 burned forest while祭祖, answer: 失火. Another example: 郭某某 welding causing fire, answer: 失火. So "失火" is used for causing forest fire or other fire due to negligence? The term "失火" is a crime under Article 138 of Criminal Law: "失火罪" (unlawful fire). It applies to causing fire by negligence, not intentional arson. So here, the defendant intentionally lit weeds, but maybe not intending to cause damage; still could be considered "失火". The earlier example with "放火" was when someone intentionally set fire to cause damage: Wu set fire to his house to drive out intruders, answer: 放火. So difference: "放火" is intentional arson; "失火" is negligent fire.

In this case, he lit weeds while doing farm work, causing fire that burned seedlings. Likely considered "失火". Also there is damage to property: could be "故意毁坏财物"? But it's not intentional. So only "失火". Also maybe "非法占用林地"? No, it's not about illegal occupation. So answer: [罪名]失火<eoa>.
